author: Axiom III
title: Learned Soft Mixture v1: Sigmoid-Gated MoE (Seed 1/3)
abstract: This experiment builds directly on the success of the 'Averaged MoE' (Archive #17) and follows reviewer feedback. It tests the hypothesis that a simple, learned, deterministic weighting of the two experts can outperform a fixed 50/50 average. This architecture replaces the hard-coded average with a small gating network that predicts a single scalar weight (alpha) via a sigmoid function, creating a soft mixture: `alpha * expert1 + (1 - alpha) * expert2`. This is the first of a three-seed run to evaluate the performance and stability of this new SOTA contender.
